title: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier Guard, Washington DC, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Tomb of Unknown Soldier Washington D. C June 4, 5, 1949
description: A black and white snapshot taken in June 1949 depicting an honor guard standing watch at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier near Washington, D.C. Ceremonial wreaths rest at the base of the monument while tourists watch from the left side of the plaza. Taken in the post-World War II era, the image captures a moment of national remembrance and military honor.
